FAQ

What is the Momcozy Wellness 1 warm-massage breast pump and why do the warmth and massage features help with milk flow?

The Momcozy Wellness 1 (Momcozy W1) is a warm-massage breast pump. It is the first wearable pump to use our industry-first rhythmic massage and wraparound warmth. This combined approach is key:

1. The gentle heat relaxes your breast tissue and milk ducts, just like a warm compress.

2. The rhythmic massage breast pump uses soothing vibrations to mimic a baby’s natural touch. This helps your body release oxytocin—the hormone needed for milk let-down—making the milk flow smoother and faster.

How does the heating feature on the Momcozy W1 work, and is it a safe heated breast pump?

The Momcozy W1 has an industry-first wraparound warmth design. This heat feature works like a built-in warm compress on the flange area. It gives wide, gentle, comforting warmth that helps your breast relax and respond naturally. The temperatures are very carefully controlled to be safe.

What is the difference between the Momcozy W1 and the Air 1?

The Momcozy Wellness 1 represents a significant shift from the Air 1. The major improvement in the W1 is the inclusion of the industry-first integrated heat and advanced rhythmic vibration massage pump technology, which the Air 1 lacks. In contrast to the Air 1, which features app connectivity and a charging case, the Momcozy W1 focuses purely on wearable comfort, warmth, and massage and app enabled but doesn't include charging case. The core benefit of the Momcozy W1 is the therapeutic warm-massage breast pump experience.

How does the Momcozy W1 compare to a standard pump?

The Momcozy W1 is both a powerful wearable pump and a heated breast pump. Standard pumps only use suction. The Momcozy W1 adds our rhythmic massage and wraparound warmth. People call it the ultimate warm-massage breast pump because the heat and massage relax your body for better milk expression.

Has the Momcozy Wellness 1 been tested for safety and does it have certifications?

Yes, absolutely! We tested the motor and all parts of the Momcozy Wellness 1 very carefully. Experts checked them to make sure they are safe, strong, and will last a long time. Rest assured that this warm-massage breast pump complies with all relevant safety standards and certifications, making it a reliable tool for your entire feeding journey.

Does the pump come with accessories or spare parts?

Yes, the Momcozy W1 includes all essential parts you need to start pumping right immediately. We also include different inserts for the flanges to meet various sizing needs, ensuring you get the perfect fit for your warm breast pump. We also offer other spare parts (like valves or collection cups) for separate purchase.

Does the Momcozy W1 require an app to work?

The Momcozy W1 offers total flexibility and
can be used with or without an app
. While the built-in LED display allows for easy manual adjustments, connecting to the app provides smart control right from your phone so you can adjust suction, warmth, and massage without needing to fumble under your blouse. Additionally, you can access expert modes ready in one tap that are specifically designed to support milk flow and make late-night pumping sessions much easier to handle.

Does W1 come with a charging case?

The W1 does not include a separate charging case, but its
built-in battery power is so strong that it matches the performance of pumps with a case
.

It features a high-capacity
2200 mAh battery
, which is much larger than many other wearable pumps. This design allows the W1 to be powerful yet simple to carry.

On a single full charge, the W1 provides industry-leading runtime:

Up to 10 sessions
(Standard Mode) — for reference, some pumps with charging cases offer around 15 sessions in total, making the W1’s 10-session standalone power very impressive.

Up to 6 sessions
(Warm-Massage Mode)

This high-capacity design ensures you have enough power for both day and night use without needing to carry a bulky extra charging case.

Is there a carrying or travel bag included?

W1 does not include a dedicated carrying or travel bag by default.

Its compact design makes it easy to store in most personal bags, backpacks, or baby bags.

Global No.1 Wearable Breast Pump Brand*

*According to Grand View Research's Wearable Breast Pump Market Analysis and Segment Forecasts to 2030 (2024), Momcozy ranked No.1 globally in the Wearable Breast Pump category based on total market share in 2024. Rankings are based on the methodology and market definition used in the report.
